prompt: Gray counts stars from the rooftop
title: Bright Rooftop Stars
irony: Gray climbs to count every star exactly, but she only truly sees them when she stops counting and dances.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Green, Navy and Gray climb the big-house rooftop with blankets under a black starry sky.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green wants to count every star tonight and corrects Gray's chart with a library fact.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black dares them to finish before the porch light blinks and shines his torch across the sky.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: All four chant under the sky while Gray ticks boxes on her star chart.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Green freezes without his book, Gray recounts from one, and Navy gives away the counters.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Gray slips on a blanket, spins into her secret dance, and the charts fly off the roof.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: They chant again while torches wobble and the flying charts land in the street.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gray holds Navy close and hums softly about plans hiding the sky.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gray drops the chart and chooses to dance with the kids instead of counting.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: They chant the hook once more while Gray sings the dance, not the count, wins.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: They hum the hook on the blankets, back on the rooftop, dancing slow under bright stars.
